people.name: Anak
people.line: Ancestor of giant people in Canaan

people.name: Arba
people.line: Father of Anak, former name of Hebron

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

translations.web: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.
translations.bsb: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath-arba, after Arba, the greatest man among the Anakim.) Then the land had rest from war.
translations.kjv: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.
translations.asv: Now the name of Hebron beforetime was Kiriath-arba; which Arba was the greatest man among the Anakim. And the land had rest from war.
